charge:
EEOC FORM 5 (11/09)
CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Charge No. ____________
EEOC Office: Atlanta District Office
Charging Party: Cameron Whitaker
City/State: Columbus, OH
Respondent: Ironwood Staffing Inc.
DISCRIMINATION BASED ON: Color, Disability
DATE(S) DISCRIMINATION TOOK PLACE: Earliest 08/17/2025 Latest 12/27/2025
THE PARTICULARS ARE:
1. I was employed by Ironwood Staffing Inc beginning before August 17, 2025. The conduct
described below began on or about August 17, 2025 and continued through December 27, 2025.
2. I was issued written discipline for conduct that similarly situated employees engaged in
without consequence.
3. I applied for a promotion for which I was qualified and was denied it in favor of a less
experienced employee.
4. I believe I have been discriminated against because of my color and disability, in violation
of applicable federal law.
